messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty INC12345 fired: GPU vmem pressure detected on pool-gamma. metric gpu_mem_free_pct < 5% for 2m. affected hosts: gpu-rt-04, gpu-rt-09. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/gpu-vmem-pressure. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification sent to on-call. Escalation policy: gpu-infra (primary: Sam K, secondary: Asha R).

Sam K: acking INC12345. I'm oncall for the next 45m, taking lead.

pagerduty-bot: User Sam K acknowledged INC12345 at 2025-08-12 15:33:05 UTC.

Asha R: jumping in — seeing increased kv-cache evictions and prefetch burst on those nodes. nvtop shows memory pinned at ~98%. Kernel logs show repeated CUDA allocation failures.

Diego L: pasting recent error from gpu-rt-04 logs:
```
2025-08-12T15:30:48Z ERROR runtime: CUBLAS_ALLOC failed: out of memory
2025-08-12T15:30:48Z WARN serving: batch 0 failed to reserve 6.9GB for kvcache
2025-08-12T15:31:02Z INFO evictor: evicted 1200 prefixes from kvcache (peak eviction rate)
```

Priya M: customer note — Siftr support pinged success@siftr complaining about intermittent 503s on embed endpoint starting ~15:28 UTC. Ticket #SIF-482. Potential customer impact: low to medium for subset of requests.

Sam K: plan: 1) reduce prefetch parallelism 2) lower model max_batch_size temporarily 3) scale up a warm spare pool if capacity allows. Trying quick config change first.

Asha R: agree. prefetch is noisy. Suggest setting KV_PREFETCH_PARALLEL=3 on pool-gamma workers + lower eviction aggressiveness. If that doesn't stabilize, we drain one host and migrate traffic.

Sam K: running patch now — command: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/kv-prefetcher KV_PREFETCH_PARALLEL=3 --context=prod --selector=pool=gamma
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/kv-prefetcher -l pool=gamma
```

infra-bot: Started rolling restart of deployment/kv-prefetcher (pool=gamma). 2/6 updated, progressing.

Diego L: also issuing temporary pod patch to limit model batch size: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch deployment llm-gamma --type=json -p '[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value", "value":"16"}]' --context=prod
```

Sam K: noticed a heavy long-tail job from batch-runner-7 on gpu-rt-09 — it's pinned large KV segments. I'm going to mark that pod for preemptive eviction.

Priya M: updating Siftr support with status: investigating, mitigation in progress (prefetch throttling + reduced batch sizes). ETA 15-20m.

Asha R: monitoring metrics. evictions dropping after restart of kv-prefetcher pods, but one host still has persistent pinned allocations. nvtop shows a process PID 4312 (batch-sq) holding memory.

Sam K: running infra drain for gpu-rt-09 to move volatile workloads off. Command: `redwood infra drain-node --host gpu-rt-09 --reason "vmem pressure" --soft-evict`

infra-bot: Drain started for gpu-rt-09. Estimated time to move pods: ~4 minutes. Evicting non-critical batch jobs.

Diego L: while draining, we should also enable auto-fallback to smaller model variant for high-latency routes to avoid customer errors. Patching route table to prefer gpt-small-quantized for pool-gamma requests.

Sam K: applied route fallback: `redwood router set-fallback --route /embed --primary pool-gamma --fallback pool-gamma-small --ttl 10m`

pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer set — if not resolved in 10m, incident will escalate to infra lead Asha R (already present) and oncall manager.

Asha R: drain finished. gpu-rt-09 freed ~28GB after evicting batch-sq. memory_free_pct climbed to 26% on that host. Monitoring other host gpu-rt-04.

Sam K: good signal. latency p50/p95 for embed endpoint dropping back to baseline for most customers. Siftr reported 503s stopped. Confirming with traces.

Priya M: Siftr says errors look resolved on their end — thanks. I'll keep them posted and close ticket when we reach steady state.

Diego L: one more item — we should add a short-term runbook step: when kv-prefetch evict rate > 500/min trigger prefetch throttle and mark noisy batchers for eviction. Filing a follow-up infra task.

Asha R: filing the follow-up: INFRA-1892 — prefetch throttle automation + alert tuning. Assign to Diego.

Sam K: wrapping up — metrics stable for 8 minutes, evictions back to normal, no CUDA errors after evictions. I'll stay on this until handoff.

Priya M: prepared customer postmortem stub and will paste details once incident is closed.

Sam K: handing off to Priya M for next 45m watch. If anything spikes, page oncall again.

pagerduty-bot: User Sam K resolved INC12345 at 2025-08-12 15:45:22 UTC. Incident status: resolved.

Priya M: Confirmed steady state at 15:45 UTC. Closing incident thread. Final notes: root cause — kv-prefetch concurrency + a long-running batch job pinned GPU memory leading to kvcache thrash and CUDA alloc failures. Mitigations applied: prefetch parallelism reduced, model batch size lowered, noisy batch job evicted, route fallback enabled. Follow-ups: INFRA-1892 (automation), SLO review for embed endpoint, customer comms. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Postmortem checklist created: https://internal/pm/INC12345/postmortem

Sam K: thanks all. Good coordination. :thumbsup:
